mcp_comments.comment: 2026-09-12 correction to P21 interpretation: SSM20 pointer4B77C reaches this getter. Reads scheduled/inhibit-filtered C0B8 plus latency C0D8, then 258C rounds/clamps to a byte with256-us steps. 26F8C sets C0B8=0 when injector recordBFB8+1 is inhibited; C0D8 remains the independent common latency. Thus P21 can stay nonzero during cut (latency alone), but it is NOT wholly upstream of channel inhibition. Actual317B4/258C and scheduler execution verifies1000us pulse+1000us latency=>byte8(2.048ms), after sustained B744003F cut=>byte4(1.024ms). Repeated9..10ms P21 values during logged bog argue against a continuous all-six cut after scheduler convergence. Short/intermittent cuts, snapshot timing, and physical electrical delivery remain unobserved.

standard_p21_correction.limitation: An inference against sustained all-six inhibition from repeated long P21 durations is not exclusion of brief or intermittent cuts, and is not proof of actual injector or ignition delivery.

comments.comment: 2026-09-12 loaded-cutout audit: separate native diagnostic fuel-cut selector, not the primary rev limiter. 6537A returns 2 for D273/02. That route at 254FC uses BF93/80: set by B544 RPM >= 3000 (764C4), held down to 2500 inclusive, cleared below 2500 (764C4 minus 764C8=500). It sets BF90 bits FE and tails 1C5D4, publishing B744=003F with other faults clear: all six injector channels inhibited. Other branches retain their own diagnostic qualifications and patterns. Actual ROM instruction tests verify clear, trip, hysteresis, release, both CD86 lift modes and received C6FC/10 -> D273/80 -> D273/02 after two accepted frames. The driving log omits these flags; this is a matching mechanism, not proof it triggered on the vehicle. Do not bypass the throttle-system protection without establishing and repairing its fault source. Later same-day sampled-RPM replay limit: RPM falls to 2377 at73.146s; the held D27302 fixture then gives B744=0000 throughout77..85.25s because RPM never returns to3000. Thus this route cannot explain all sustained low-lift bog on the sampled history; do not elevate the matching threshold into a diagnosis.

2026-09-12: returns 2 when diagnostic summary D273 bit 02 is set, else 0. 253A8 uses this to qualify its 3000/2500 RPM all-six-injector cut path. D273/02 is ORed from D273 masks 80,40,20,10,08 by 64874 at 64E6E..64ED4; it is not the added lean-cut state and not a direct load threshold.

2026-09-12: sets D273/02 when any D273/80,40,20,10,08 input is active. Getter6537A exposes this as 2; native253A8 can then inhibit all six injectors at RPM>=3000, releasing below2500. Sources include local pedal/throttle/link diagnostic state and accepted received fault bits C6F7..C6FD. Driving activation is unobserved in the 14:42 profile. Existing 64B8E R13 overwrite correction still applies; pseudocode alone does not establish source identities.

2026-09-12 pressure-compensation clarification: CFBC barometric pressure minus B2A0 retained MAP indexes descriptor5F470/data76AC8 for the separate throttle-tip-in supplemental pulse. This is not a global rail-pressure correction to the normal P21 pulse. V2 currently neutralizes all eight pressure multipliers to1. B874 and P21 do not independently measure this added asynchronous pulse.
